title: The Jewel
description:
You have found the JEWEL of Mt. Juliet!  This family friendly home sits in a safe, quiet neighborhood.  It is 2.5 miles away from the Providence Marketplace with plenty of
shopping/dining.  We are less than 20 miles from downtown Nashville, 13 miles from the airport.  The game room downstairs includes a 55" TV and pool table.  BBQ on the deck or relax by the fire pit. This home sleeps 7 with 4 beds and a futon.   A great location for those looking for adventure in and around the Nashville area.
